# Offline captured regressions

These selected, sanitized fixtures replace undeclared dependencies on a developer's ignored artifacts. They are test input, not live acceptance or spending authorization. `manifest.json` enumerates the only redirected paths. Jest's `capturedFixturesBootstrap.js` redirects reads inside the test process; no private acceptance files are materialized. Ordinary evaluators retain their original fail-closed file paths.

Source captures were collected previously; no provider requests were made to package them. Personal/session identifiers are deterministically pseudonymized, contact/network/device fields are redacted, local user paths and credential patterns are removed. The source-text fixture is read as text only. Evidence, itinerary content and accounting dimensions needed for existing assertions are retained. The two test adjudications bind the sanitized fixture bytes, not the original private records. This does not reauthorize any live evaluation.

Unknown paths still fail; tests are not skipped when evidence is absent. Historical regression outputs remain disposable ignored artifacts. All runtime network guards remain active.
